name: Idli with Sambar
advancePrep: Soak rice and dal 6 h, grind, ferment 8–12 h
steps: Steam the fermented batter in greased idli moulds for 10–12 minutes; rest 2 minutes before unmoulding.
Pressure-cook toor dal with turmeric until soft; mash.
Simmer drumstick, shallots and tomato in tamarind water with sambar powder until tender, then add the dal.
Temper mustard seeds, urad dal, red chilli, curry leaves and hing in oil; pour over the sambar and garnish with coriander.

name: Dosa with Coconut Chutney
advancePrep: Batter soaked 6 h and fermented overnight
steps: Heat a cast-iron tawa, spread a ladle of batter thin in circles and drizzle a few drops of oil.
Cook until golden and crisp underneath, then fold.
Grind coconut, roasted chana dal, chilli, ginger and salt with a little water for the chutney.
Temper mustard seeds, urad dal and curry leaves in a little oil and pour over the chutney.

name: Masala Dosa
advancePrep: Batter soaked 6 h and fermented overnight
steps: Boil potatoes, peel and crumble coarsely.
Temper mustard seeds, urad dal and curry leaves; sauté sliced onion and chilli, add turmeric, potato and salt.
Spread dosa batter thin on a hot tawa, drizzle oil and cook until crisp.
Place filling in the centre, fold and serve with coconut chutney.

name: Vegetable Rava Upma
steps: Dry-roast semolina until aromatic; set aside.
Temper mustard seeds, urad dal, curry leaves and chilli; sauté onion, ginger and diced vegetables until just tender.
Add 2.5 parts boiling water to 1 part semolina with salt, then rain in the semolina while stirring.
Cover and cook 2 minutes on low; finish with lemon juice and coriander.

name: Ven Pongal
steps: Dry-roast moong dal lightly, then pressure-cook with rice and 4 parts water until very soft.
Heat ghee; fry crushed pepper, cumin, ginger, curry leaves and cashews.
Stir the tempering into the rice-dal, add salt and loosen with hot water.
Serve hot with coconut chutney.

name: Pesarattu (Green Moong Dosa)
steps: Grind soaked moong, rice, ginger, chilli and cumin into a smooth batter; season.
Spread thin on a hot tawa, sprinkle chopped onion and coriander, drizzle oil.
Cook until crisp, fold and serve with a quick ginger-tamarind chutney.

name: Instant Ragi Dosa
steps: Whisk ragi flour, rice flour, chopped onion, chilli, cumin and salt with water into a thin pourable batter.
Pour from a height onto a very hot tawa to make a lacy dosa; drizzle oil.
Cook until the edges lift and serve with coconut chutney.

name: Appam with Vegetable Stew
advancePrep: Batter soaked 4 h and fermented overnight
steps: Swirl fermented appam batter in a hot appachatti, cover and cook until the centre is spongy and edges lacy.
Sauté whole spices, onion, ginger and chilli in coconut oil.
Add diced vegetables with a little water and cook until tender.
Pour in coconut milk, warm through without boiling, season and finish with curry leaves.

name: Puttu with Kadala Curry
steps: Moisten rice flour with salted water until it holds when pressed; layer with grated coconut in the puttu maker and steam 8 minutes.
Pressure-cook soaked chana until soft.
Roast coconut until brown and grind with coriander and chilli powder to a paste.
Sauté onion and tomato in coconut oil, add paste and chana with cooking water, simmer 10 minutes; temper mustard seeds and curry leaves.

name: Onion Tomato Uttapam
steps: Spread a thick ladle of batter on a hot tawa.
Press finely chopped onion, tomato, capsicum, chilli and coriander on top.
Drizzle oil around, cover and cook; flip and cook 1 minute more.

name: Adai with Avial
steps: Grind soaked rice and dals coarsely with red chillies, ginger and salt; stir in curry leaves.
Spread thick on a tawa, make a hole in the centre, drizzle oil and cook both sides until crisp.
For avial, cook batons of vegetables with turmeric and little water.
Add ground coconut, cumin and chilli, then whisked curd; finish with coconut oil and curry leaves.

name: Akki Rotti
steps: Mix rice flour with grated carrot, onion, coconut, chilli, coriander, cumin and salt; add warm water to form a soft dough.
Pat thin directly onto a greased cold tawa with wet fingers; poke a few holes.
Cook covered on medium with oil around the edges until spotted, flip once.

name: Neer Dosa with Chutney
steps: Grind soaked rice with a little coconut into a very thin, watery batter; salt it.
Pour onto a hot greased pan, swirl, cover and cook 1 minute without flipping.
Fold into quarters and serve with coconut-chilli chutney.

name: Semiya Upma
steps: Roast vermicelli in a dry pan until golden.
Temper mustard seeds, urad dal and curry leaves; sauté onion and vegetables.
Add 1.5 cups water per cup vermicelli with salt, bring to a boil, add vermicelli and cook covered until absorbed.
Finish with lemon and coriander.

name: Sambar Rice with Beans Poriyal
steps: Cook rice; pressure-cook toor dal with turmeric and mash.
Simmer drumstick, brinjal, shallots and tomato in tamarind water with sambar powder, then add dal and simmer 5 minutes.
For poriyal, temper mustard seeds and urad dal, add finely chopped beans and salt, cook covered, finish with coconut.
Temper the sambar with mustard seeds, curry leaves and hing.
portion: 1 plate rice + 1 bowl sambar + ½ cup poriyal

name: Tomato Rasam, Rice and Cabbage Poriyal
steps: Crush pepper, cumin and garlic coarsely.
Simmer chopped tomato in tamarind water with the crushed spices, rasam powder and salt for 8 minutes; add thin cooked dal and bring to a froth.
Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves in oil and add to rasam with coriander.
Stir-fry shredded cabbage with a mustard seed tempering and finish with coconut; serve with rice.
portion: 1 plate rice + 1 cup rasam + ½ cup poriyal

name: Curd Rice (Thayir Sadam)
steps: Cook rice soft and mash lightly while warm; cool.
Mix in curd, a splash of milk, salt, grated carrot and cucumber.
Temper mustard seeds, urad dal, chilli, ginger and curry leaves; stir in and top with pomegranate.

name: Lemon Rice with Sundal
steps: Cook rice and spread to cool so the grains stay separate.
Temper mustard seeds, chana dal, peanuts, chilli and curry leaves; add turmeric and pour over the rice with lemon juice and salt.
For sundal, temper boiled chickpeas with mustard seeds and curry leaves and finish with coconut.
portion: 1 plate lemon rice + ½ cup chickpea sundal

name: Bisi Bele Bath
steps: Pressure-cook rice and toor dal together until mushy.
Cook vegetables in tamarind water with bisi bele bath (or sambar) powder and jaggery.
Combine with rice-dal, adding hot water for a porridge-like consistency.
Temper mustard seeds, curry leaves, hing and cashews in ghee and pour over.

name: Kerala Fish Curry with Matta Rice
steps: Cook matta rice.
In coconut oil, splutter fenugreek seeds, sauté shallots, ginger, garlic and curry leaves.
Add spice powders and tomato, then tamarind water; simmer 5 minutes.
Slide in fish, simmer gently 8 minutes, then add coconut milk and warm through.
portion: 2 pieces fish + 1 cup curry + 1 plate matta rice

name: Avial with Rice and Moru
steps: Cut vegetables into finger-length batons and cook with turmeric, salt and a little water.
Grind coconut, cumin and chilli coarsely; add to vegetables with half the curd and simmer 2 minutes.
Finish with raw coconut oil and curry leaves.
Whisk remaining curd with water, ginger and salt for moru; serve with rice.
portion: 1 plate rice + 1 bowl avial + 1 glass spiced buttermilk

name: Andhra Tomato Pappu with Rice
steps: Pressure-cook toor dal with tomatoes, onion, chillies and turmeric.
Mash well, add a little tamarind and salt, simmer 3 minutes.
Temper mustard seeds, garlic, red chilli and curry leaves in ghee; pour over and serve with rice.

name: Chicken Chettinad with Rice
steps: Dry-roast coconut, fennel, pepper, red chillies, cinnamon and cloves; grind to a paste.
Sauté onion, ginger-garlic and curry leaves in oil; add tomato and turmeric.
Add chicken and sear, then the ground masala with water; simmer covered 20 minutes until thick.
portion: 1 cup curry (150 g chicken) + 1 plate rice

name: Hyderabadi Chicken Dum Biryani
steps: Marinate chicken in curd, ginger-garlic, chilli, garam masala, mint, coriander, lemon and half the fried onions.
Parboil rice with whole spices until 70 % done; drain.
Layer marinated chicken at the bottom of a heavy pot, cover with rice, saffron milk, ghee and remaining onions.
Seal and cook on high 5 minutes then low 25 minutes; rest 10 minutes. Serve with cucumber raita.

name: Lauki Kootu with Rice
steps: Cook moong dal with diced bottle gourd and turmeric until soft but holding shape.
Grind coconut, cumin and chilli; stir into the kootu and simmer 3 minutes.
Temper with mustard seeds, urad dal and curry leaves; serve with rice.

name: Ragi Mudde with Soppu Saaru
steps: Bring water to a boil, add ragi flour in a heap, cover 2 minutes, then stir vigorously into a smooth mass; shape into a ball.
Cook toor dal with chopped greens, onion and tomato.
Add rasam powder, tamarind and salt; simmer.
Temper with mustard seeds, garlic and curry leaves.

name: Kerala Egg Roast with Appam
steps: Hard-boil eggs, peel and score lightly.
Cook sliced onions slowly in coconut oil until deep golden; add ginger, garlic and curry leaves.
Add spice powders and tomato, cook down to a thick roast, then toss in the eggs.
Serve with freshly made appams.

name: Fish Molee with Appam
steps: Rub fish with turmeric, pepper, salt and lemon; sear briefly in coconut oil and remove.
Sauté onion, ginger, garlic, chilli and curry leaves until soft.
Add thin coconut milk and simmer; return fish and cook 5 minutes.
Add thick coconut milk and tomato slices, warm through and serve with appams.

name: Cabbage Thoran, Parippu and Rice
steps: Cook rice and moong dal (separately); mash dal with turmeric and salt and finish with ghee for parippu.
Splutter mustard seeds and curry leaves in coconut oil; add finely shredded cabbage and salt.
Crush coconut, cumin, garlic and chilli coarsely, add to cabbage and toss until just cooked.
portion: 1 plate rice + ½ cup thoran + ½ cup parippu

name: Dal Tadka with Phulka
steps: Pressure-cook dals with turmeric and salt until soft; whisk.
Sauté cumin, onion, ginger, garlic and chilli in oil; add tomato and spices and cook until jammy, then stir into the dal.
Knead atta into soft dough, roll thin and puff directly on flame.
Heat ghee, sizzle cumin, red chilli and hing, pour over dal, top with coriander.

name: Rajma Chawal
steps: Pressure-cook soaked rajma until creamy (about 6–7 whistles).
Sauté cumin and bay leaf in oil, then onion until golden; add ginger, garlic, tomato and spices and cook until oil separates.
Add rajma with its liquid, mash a few beans and simmer 15 minutes.
Serve over steamed rice with sliced onion and lemon.
portion: 1 bowl rajma + 1 plate rice + onion salad

name: Chole with Brown Rice
steps: Pressure-cook soaked chickpeas until soft (a tea bag in the water gives the classic dark colour).
Sauté cumin and bay leaf, then onion until brown; add ginger, garlic, chilli, tomato and spices.
Add chickpeas with liquid, mash a few, simmer 15 minutes; finish with chaat masala and coriander.

name: Palak Paneer with Roti
steps: Blanch spinach 2 minutes, shock in cold water, and blend with green chilli.
Sauté cumin, onion, ginger and garlic; add tomato and cook down.
Add spinach purée, salt and garam masala; simmer 3 minutes.
Fold in paneer cubes and kasuri methi; serve with rotis.
portion: 1 bowl palak paneer (80 g paneer) + 2 rotis

name: Punjabi Kadhi Chawal
steps: Whisk curd, besan, turmeric, salt and 2.5 times water until smooth.
Temper fenugreek, cumin, mustard seeds and red chilli; sauté onion and ginger.
Pour in curd mixture and stir until it boils, then simmer 20 minutes on low.
Finish with kasuri methi; serve with rice.

name: Aloo Gobi with Phulka and Dal
steps: Sizzle cumin in oil, add onion and ginger, then cauliflower florets and potato cubes.
Add spice powders and salt, cover and cook on low, stirring occasionally, 15 minutes.
Add tomato and cook uncovered until dry and tender; finish with garam masala and coriander.
Serve with phulkas and a simple moong dal.
portion: 1 cup sabzi + 2 phulkas + ½ bowl dal

name: Bhindi Masala with Roti and Raita
steps: Wash and dry okra thoroughly; slice into rounds.
Sauté okra in oil on high until no longer slimy; push aside.
Add cumin, onion and tomato, then spice powders; toss with okra until dry and tender.
Finish with chaat masala. Serve with rotis and cucumber raita.
portion: 1 cup bhindi + 2 rotis + ½ cup raita

name: Baingan Bharta with Bajra Roti
steps: Roast the brinjal directly on flame until charred and collapsed; peel and mash.
Heat mustard oil to smoking, cool slightly, add cumin, onion, garlic, ginger and chilli.
Add tomato and spices and cook down, then stir in the brinjal and cook 5 minutes.
Knead bajra flour with warm water, pat into rotis and cook on a tawa.

name: Matar Paneer with Phulka
steps: Blend sautéed onion, tomato, ginger, garlic and cashews into a smooth paste.
Cook the paste with cumin and spice powders until oil separates.
Add peas and water and simmer 8 minutes; add paneer cubes and kasuri methi.

name: Lauki Chana Dal with Roti
steps: Pressure-cook soaked chana dal with diced lauki and turmeric for 3 whistles.
Sauté cumin, onion, ginger, garlic and chilli; add tomato and spices.
Stir in the dal and simmer 5 minutes; garnish with coriander.

name: Dal Makhani with Naan-style Roti
steps: Pressure-cook soaked urad and rajma until completely soft.
Cook onion, ginger and garlic in butter, add tomato purée and spices and cook 10 minutes.
Add the dal and simmer low for 30–40 minutes, mashing occasionally.
Finish with cream and kasuri methi.

name: Tandoori Chicken with Salad and Roti
steps: Marinate chicken in curd, lemon, ginger-garlic, spices, mustard oil and salt.
Roast at 230 °C (or grill/air-fry) for 20–25 minutes, turning once, until charred at the edges.
Blend mint, coriander and a spoon of curd into chutney.
Serve with onion-cucumber-tomato salad and a roti.
portion: 200 g chicken + salad + 1 roti + mint chutney

name: Home-style Chicken Curry with Rice
steps: Sauté whole spices, then onions until deep golden.
Add ginger-garlic, chilli, tomato and powders; cook until oil separates.
Add chicken and seal; stir in whisked curd and water, cover and simmer 20 minutes.
Finish with garam masala and coriander; serve with rice.
portion: 1 cup curry (150 g chicken) + 1 plate rice

name: Keema Matar with Roti
steps: Brown onion with cumin; add ginger, garlic and chilli.
Add mince and cook on high, breaking it up, until no longer pink.
Add tomato and spices, then peas and a splash of water; simmer covered 15 minutes.

name: Sarson ka Saag with Makki Roti
steps: Pressure-cook chopped greens with ginger, chilli and salt; mash or pulse coarsely.
Whisk in a spoon of makki atta and simmer 20 minutes, stirring.
Temper onion and garlic in ghee and stir into the saag.
Knead makki atta with warm water, pat into rotis between sheets and cook on a tawa.
portion: 1 bowl saag + 2 makki rotis + a little jaggery

name: Kashmiri Rogan Josh with Rice
steps: Heat oil, add whole spices and hing, then sear the mutton until browned.
Mix Kashmiri chilli powder with water and add; cook 2 minutes.
Stir in whisked curd gradually, then ground fennel and dry ginger; add water.
Cover and simmer 45–50 minutes until tender; finish with garam masala.
portion: 1 cup curry (150 g mutton) + 1 plate rice

name: Gatte ki Sabzi with Roti
steps: Knead besan with ajwain, spices, a spoon of curd and a little oil; roll into logs.
Boil the logs 10 minutes, cool and slice into pieces; keep the water.
Cook onion, tomato and spices, add whisked curd and the boiling water, stirring constantly.
Add gatte and simmer 8 minutes; serve with rotis.

name: Dal Baati
steps: Knead atta, semolina, ajwain, salt and some ghee into a stiff dough; shape balls.
Bake at 200 °C for 30–35 minutes, turning, until cracked and golden; dip in warm ghee.
Cook the mixed dals soft; temper with cumin, onion, tomato and spices.

name: Moong Dal Khichdi with Kadhi-style Curd
steps: Rinse rice and dal; heat ghee and sizzle cumin, hing and ginger.
Add rice, dal, vegetables, turmeric, salt and 4 parts water.
Pressure-cook 4 whistles; loosen with hot water. Serve with curd.

name: Veg Tehri with Raita
steps: Soak rice 20 minutes.
Sizzle cumin and bay leaf, sauté onion, ginger and tomato, add vegetables and spices.
Add drained rice and 2 parts water with salt; cook covered on low until done.
Serve with curd raita.

name: Kafuli with Brown Rice
steps: Blanch spinach and fenugreek leaves and coarsely grind with ginger, garlic and chilli.
Heat mustard oil, sizzle cumin, add greens with turmeric and salt.
Stir in rice-flour slurry and simmer until thick; serve with rice.

name: Paneer Bhurji with Roti
steps: Sizzle cumin, sauté onion, chilli and capsicum.
Add tomato, turmeric, chilli powder and salt; cook 2 minutes.
Crumble in paneer and toss on high for 2 minutes; finish with coriander.

name: Aloo Paratha with Curd
steps: Mash boiled potatoes with chilli, coriander, ajwain, spices and salt.
Stuff into balls of atta dough, seal and roll out gently.
Cook on a hot tawa, brushing lightly with ghee, until golden spots appear on both sides.
Serve with curd.

name: Methi Thepla with Curd
steps: Knead atta, besan, chopped methi, spices, ginger, sesame and a spoon of curd into a soft dough.
Roll thin and cook on a tawa with a few drops of oil until spotted.
Serve warm with curd.

name: Besan Chilla with Mint Chutney
steps: Whisk besan with water, spices and salt into a smooth batter; stir in onion, tomato, chilli and coriander.
Pour onto a hot greased pan, spread into a circle and cook both sides until golden.
Blend mint, coriander, chilli and lemon into chutney.

name: Moong Dal Chilla with Paneer
steps: Grind soaked moong dal with ginger, chilli, cumin and salt into a smooth batter.
Spread on a hot tawa, drizzle oil, and cook until the edges lift.
Sprinkle crumbled paneer, onion, capsicum and coriander; fold and serve.

name: Vegetable Dalia
steps: Roast dalia in a pressure cooker with a little oil until fragrant; remove.
Sizzle cumin, sauté onion, ginger, chilli, tomato and vegetables.
Add dalia, moong dal, turmeric, salt and 3.5 parts water; pressure-cook 3 whistles.

name: Masala Oats
steps: Sauté mustard seeds, cumin, onion and chilli; add vegetables and tomato.
Add oats, spices, salt and 1.5 cups water; simmer 4 minutes, stirring.
Finish with lemon and coriander.

name: Egg Bhurji with Roti
steps: Sauté onion and chilli until soft; add tomato, turmeric, chilli powder and salt.
Pour in beaten eggs and scramble on medium until just set.
Garnish with coriander and serve with rotis.

name: Masala Omelette with Toast
steps: Beat eggs with onion, tomato, chilli, coriander, turmeric, pepper and salt.
Cook in an oiled pan on medium until set; flip and fold.
Serve with whole wheat toast.

name: Chole Bhature
advancePrep: Soak chickpeas overnight; rest dough 2 h
steps: Make chole as usual: cook soaked chickpeas, then simmer in an onion-tomato-spice masala.
Knead maida with curd, soda, salt and a little oil; rest 2 hours.
Roll into ovals and deep-fry in hot oil until puffed and golden.

name: Poori Bhaji
steps: Knead a stiff atta dough with salt and a little oil; roll small discs.
Deep-fry in hot oil until puffed.
Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves, sauté onion, chilli and ginger, add turmeric and crushed boiled potato.

name: Kanda Poha
steps: Rinse poha in a sieve until soft but not mushy; drain.
Fry peanuts in oil, then mustard seeds, curry leaves, chilli, hing and onion (and diced potato if using).
Add turmeric, salt, sugar and poha; toss gently, cover 2 minutes.
Finish with lemon, coriander and grated coconut.

name: Thalipeeth with Curd
steps: Mix the flours with onion, coriander, chilli, spices and salt; add water to make a soft dough.
Pat thin onto a greased tawa or plastic sheet; make 4 holes and pour oil in each.
Cook covered until crisp underneath, flip and cook the other side.

name: Sabudana Khichdi
steps: Drain soaked sabudana; toss with crushed roasted peanuts, salt and sugar.
Heat ghee, sizzle cumin, chilli and curry leaves; add cubed boiled potato.
Add sabudana and stir on low until pearls turn translucent, 5–6 minutes; finish with lemon.

name: Khaman Dhokla
steps: Whisk besan, sugar, salt, turmeric, lemon and water into a smooth batter.
Stir in fruit salt/soda just before steaming; pour into a greased tin and steam 15 minutes.
Temper mustard seeds, sesame, chilli and curry leaves in oil with a little water and sugar; pour over the cut dhokla.

name: Handvo
advancePrep: Soak rice and dals 4 h; ferment 6 h
steps: Grind soaked rice and dals coarsely with curd; ferment.
Mix in grated lauki and carrot, ginger, chilli, salt and soda.
Temper mustard and sesame seeds in a pan, pour in batter, cover and cook on low 15 minutes per side (or bake at 180 °C for 40 minutes).

name: Misal Pav
advancePrep: Sprout moth or moong beans 1–2 days
steps: Cook sprouts with turmeric and salt until just tender.
Roast onion and coconut, grind with ginger, garlic and spices.
Fry the paste in oil, add tomato, water, tamarind and sprouts; simmer to a spicy thin curry.
Top with chopped onion, coriander and lemon; serve with pav.

name: Varan Bhaat with Koshimbir
steps: Pressure-cook toor dal with turmeric and hing until very soft; whisk with salt and a pinch of jaggery.
Serve dal over hot rice with a spoon of ghee.
Toss cucumber, tomato, crushed peanuts, lemon and salt for the koshimbir.

name: Pithla Bhakri
steps: Temper mustard, cumin, garlic, chilli and curry leaves; sauté onion.
Pour in besan whisked with 4 parts water, turmeric and salt; stir constantly until thick and glossy.
Knead jowar flour with hot water, pat into bhakris and cook on a tawa, sprinkling water on top.

name: Bharli Vangi with Bhakri
steps: Roast peanuts, coconut, sesame and onion; grind with garlic, jaggery, tamarind and spices.
Slit small brinjals crosswise, stuff with the masala.
Cook in oil with mustard seeds, covered on low with a splash of water, 20 minutes.
Serve with jowar bhakri.

name: Gujarati Kadhi Khichdi
steps: Pressure-cook rice and moong dal with turmeric and salt.
Whisk curd with besan, water, jaggery, ginger and chilli; simmer, stirring, 10 minutes.
Temper cumin, mustard, clove, cinnamon and curry leaves in ghee and pour into the kadhi.

name: Undhiyu with Puri
steps: Make small methi muthiya from besan, methi and spices; steam or shallow-fry.
Grind coconut, coriander, chilli, ginger, garlic, peanuts and spices into green masala; stuff into slit baby brinjal and potatoes.
Layer all vegetables in oil with ajwain, cover and cook on low 30 minutes.
Add muthiya, cook 10 minutes more; serve with rotis.

name: Goan Fish Curry Rice
steps: Grind coconut with soaked red chillies, coriander, cumin, pepper, turmeric, garlic and tamarind into a smooth paste.
Sauté onion and tomato in oil, add the paste and water and simmer 8 minutes.
Add fish and cook gently 6–8 minutes; serve with rice.
portion: 1 cup curry (140 g fish) + 1 plate rice

name: Pav Bhaji
steps: Boil potato, cauliflower, peas and carrot; mash.
Cook onion, garlic and capsicum in half the butter, add tomato and pav bhaji masala and cook down.
Add the mashed vegetables and water, mash together and simmer 10 minutes.
Toast pav with the remaining butter; top bhaji with onion, coriander and lemon.

name: Sindhi Sai Bhaji with Rice
steps: Pressure-cook soaked chana dal with greens, chopped vegetables, ginger and chilli.
Mash or whisk to a coarse purée.
Temper cumin, garlic, onion and tomato with spices and stir in; simmer 5 minutes.

name: Macher Jhol with Rice
steps: Rub fish with turmeric and salt; lightly fry in smoking mustard oil and set aside.
Temper panch phoron-style seeds, add potato wedges and fry briefly.
Add ginger paste, cumin, chilli, tomato and water; simmer until potatoes are soft.
Slide in fish and simmer 5 minutes; garnish with chillies and coriander.
portion: 2 fish pieces in light curry + 1 plate rice

name: Cholar Dal with Rice and Begun Bhaja
steps: Cook soaked chana dal until soft but whole.
Temper ghee with cumin, bay leaf and whole spices; add ginger, coconut slivers and raisins.
Add dal, sugar and salt and simmer 5 minutes.
Rub brinjal slices with turmeric, chilli and salt; pan-fry until golden.
portion: 1 bowl dal + 1 plate rice + 2 brinjal slices

name: Odia Dalma with Rice
steps: Cook toor dal with turmeric until half done.
Add chunks of pumpkin, raw banana, brinjal and potato and cook until tender.
Dry-roast cumin and red chilli and grind; add to the dalma.
Temper ghee with cumin and red chilli, pour over and top with coconut.

name: Pakhala Bhata with Sides
advancePrep: Ferment cooked rice in water 8–12 h
steps: Soak leftover cooked rice in water and let ferment; stir in curd, salt and roasted cumin.
Temper curry leaves and chilli in a drop of oil and add with mint.
Roast brinjal and boiled potato; mash each with onion, chilli, mustard oil and salt.
portion: 1 bowl pakhala + roasted brinjal + potato bharta

name: Chirer Pulao
steps: Rinse poha and drain.
Fry peanuts and cashews in oil; add cumin, bay leaf, ginger, diced potato, carrot and peas and cook until tender.
Add poha, salt, sugar, raisins and a pinch of turmeric; toss gently.

name: Ghugni
advancePrep: Soak dried peas or kala chana overnight
steps: Pressure-cook soaked chana with diced potato.
Sauté cumin, bay leaf and onion; add ginger, tomato and spices.
Add chana with liquid and simmer thick; top with raw onion, coriander and tamarind water.

name: Litti Chokha
steps: Mix sattu with onion, garlic, ginger, chilli, lemon, ajwain, mustard oil and salt for the filling.
Stuff into balls of atta dough and bake at 200 °C for 25–30 minutes, turning, until cracked; brush with ghee.
Roast brinjal, tomato and potato, peel and mash with mustard oil, garlic, chilli and coriander for chokha.

name: Chingri Malai Curry with Rice
steps: Toss prawns with turmeric and salt; sear briefly in ghee and remove.
Fry whole spices, then onion paste and ginger until light brown.
Add coconut milk, sugar and chilli; simmer 5 minutes, return prawns and cook 3 minutes.
portion: 1 cup curry (130 g prawns) + 1 plate rice

name: Masor Tenga with Rice
steps: Rub fish with turmeric and salt; lightly fry in mustard oil.
Splutter fenugreek seeds, add chopped tomato and cook until mushy.
Add ridge gourd and water, simmer, then the fish for 5 minutes.
Finish with lemon juice, chillies and coriander.
portion: 2 fish pieces in sour curry + 1 plate rice

name: Assamese Khar with Rice
steps: Cook diced raw papaya and lentils with a pinch of soda (stand-in for traditional banana-ash khar) and salt.
Temper garlic and fenugreek in mustard oil and pour over.
Mash a little extra cooked dal with raw onion, chilli and mustard oil as pitika on the side.
portion: 1 bowl khar + 1 plate rice + masoor pitika

name: Naga Pork with Bamboo Shoot
steps: Simmer pork pieces with ginger, garlic and salt in a covered pot until they release fat and turn tender.
Add sliced fermented bamboo shoot and crushed roasted chillies; cook down until thick.
Boil cabbage and greens with a little salt and chilli as the side; serve with rice.
portion: 1 cup (130 g pork) + 1 plate rice + boiled greens

name: Jadoh
steps: Brown pork pieces in a little oil with onion, ginger and garlic.
Add plenty of turmeric, pepper and bay leaf, then washed rice and water.
Cook covered on low until rice is done and fragrant; serve with cucumber slices.

name: Vegetable Thukpa
steps: Sauté onion, garlic and ginger in oil; add tomato and cook soft.
Add water, soy sauce and vegetables; simmer 6 minutes.
Cook noodles separately, place in bowls and ladle soup over; finish with spring onion, pepper and chilli.

name: Steamed Veg Momos with Tomato Chutney
steps: Knead maida with water into a firm dough; rest 20 minutes.
Sauté finely chopped vegetables with garlic, ginger, soy and salt; cool.
Roll small thin circles, fill and pleat; steam 10–12 minutes.
Blend roasted tomato, red chillies and garlic with salt for the chutney.

name: Eromba with Rice
steps: Boil potato, beans, pumpkin and bamboo shoot until soft.
Roast dry chillies and pound with salt (traditionally with fermented fish).
Mash vegetables with the chilli and a little cooking water; fold in spring onion and coriander.

name: Mizo Bai (Vegetable Stew)
steps: Bring water to a boil with a pinch of soda, salt, ginger and chilli.
Add pumpkin, brinjal and beans, then bamboo shoot and greens.
Simmer until everything is soft; serve with rice.

name: Jolpan (Poha, Curd and Jaggery)
steps: Rinse poha (chira) briefly and drain.
Top with thick curd, crumbled jaggery and sliced banana; mix and eat.

name: Chak-hao Kheer
steps: Simmer soaked black rice in milk on low, stirring often, until creamy and purple, about 35 minutes.
Off heat, stir in jaggery and cardamom; top with cashews.

name: Indori Poha
steps: Rinse poha, mix with turmeric, salt and sugar; rest 5 minutes.
Temper mustard and fennel seeds, chilli and curry leaves; add onion and peas.
Add poha and steam covered on low 3 minutes; top with pomegranate, coriander and lemon.

name: Bhutte ka Kees
steps: Grate fresh corn cobs (or pulse kernels coarsely).
Temper mustard, cumin, hing and chilli in ghee; add corn and turmeric and cook 5 minutes.
Add milk and cook, stirring, until thick; finish with lemon, coriander and coconut.

name: Chawal ka Chila with Tomato Chutney
steps: Whisk rice flour with water, onion, chilli, coriander, cumin and salt into a thin batter.
Pour onto a hot greased tawa, spread and cook until edges crisp; flip briefly.
Roast tomato and garlic and mash with salt and chilli for the chutney.

name: Moong Sprouts Chaat
steps: Steam sprouts 4–5 minutes until just tender.
Toss with chopped onion, tomato, cucumber, chilli and pomegranate.
Season with lemon, chaat masala, salt and coriander.

name: Roasted Masala Makhana
steps: Roast makhana in ghee on low heat for 6–8 minutes until crisp.
Toss with pepper, chaat masala, turmeric and salt.

name: Light Bhel Puri
steps: Make a quick sweet-sour chutney by simmering tamarind with jaggery; blend mint, coriander and chilli for the green chutney.
Just before eating, toss puffed rice with peanuts, diced vegetables and boiled potato.
Add both chutneys, lemon and chaat masala; serve immediately.

name: Chickpea Sundal
steps: Boil soaked chickpeas until tender; drain.
Temper mustard seeds, urad dal, chillies, curry leaves and hing.
Toss chickpeas in, season and finish with grated coconut.

name: Sattu Sharbat
steps: Whisk sattu into cold water until lump-free.
Add lemon, roasted cumin, black salt, mint and chopped onion if you like.

name: Jaggery Rice Kheer
steps: Simmer washed rice in milk on low, stirring, until rice is soft and milk reduces by a third.
Turn off heat, let it cool slightly, then stir in jaggery (so the milk does not split).
Flavour with cardamom and saffron; top with sliced almonds.

name: Semiya Payasam
steps: Roast vermicelli, cashews and raisins in ghee.
Add milk and simmer until vermicelli is soft.
Cool slightly, stir in jaggery and cardamom.

name: Ragi Date Ladoo
steps: Roast ragi flour in ghee on low until aromatic.
Blend dates and almonds to a sticky paste.
Mix with warm ragi and cardamom; shape into ladoos.

name: Light Gajar Halwa
steps: Grate carrots and cook in milk until the milk is absorbed.
Add ghee and jaggery and stir-fry until glossy.
Finish with cardamom, almonds and raisins.

name: Coconut Jaggery Ladoo
steps: Melt jaggery with a splash of water, add grated coconut and stir on low until it comes together.
Add cardamom and chopped cashews; shape into ladoos while warm.

name: Nolen Gur Sandesh
steps: Knead fresh chhena (paneer) until smooth.
Cook with jaggery on low 6–8 minutes until it leaves the pan; cool slightly.
Knead again, shape, and top with cardamom and pistachios.

name: Phirni
steps: Soak rice and grind to a coarse paste.
Simmer milk, add rice paste and stir constantly until thick, about 15 minutes.
Add sugar, cardamom and rose water; set in bowls and chill. Top with pistachios.

name: Shrikhand with Fresh Fruit
steps: Whisk hung curd until smooth with honey, cardamom and saffron.
Fold in diced mango (or seasonal fruit) and top with pistachios.

name: Til Gud Chikki
steps: Toast sesame seeds until they pop.
Melt jaggery with ghee to the hard-ball stage, stir in sesame quickly.
Spread thin on a greased surface, score while warm and break when set.

name: Khajur Pak (Date Nut Bites)
steps: Warm chopped dates in ghee until soft and mashable.
Mix in toasted chopped nuts; roll into a log in desiccated coconut.
Chill, then slice.

name: Sooji Halwa
steps: Roast semolina in ghee until golden and fragrant.
Carefully add hot sugar syrup (sugar dissolved in 3 parts water); stir until thick.
Finish with cardamom and fried nuts and raisins.

name: Manakish Za'atar with Salad
steps: Knead the flours with yeast, sugar, salt and warm water into a soft dough; let rise 1 hour.
Mix za'atar with olive oil to a loose paste.
Press the dough into a thin round, spread the za’atar oil, and bake at 250 °C for 7–9 minutes.
Serve with sliced tomato, cucumber, mint and olives.

name: Foul Mudammas
advancePrep: Soak dried fava beans overnight and boil 1 h (or use canned)
steps: Simmer cooked fava beans in a little of their liquid until very soft.
Mash roughly with crushed garlic, lemon juice, cumin and salt.
Top with diced tomato, parsley and a drizzle of olive oil; serve with pita, radish and mint.

name: Balila (Warm Spiced Chickpeas)
steps: Warm cooked chickpeas in their liquid.
Drain and toss with crushed garlic, lemon juice, cumin, salt and olive oil.
Finish with parsley.

name: Labneh Breakfast Plate
steps: Spread labneh on a plate, make a well and fill with olive oil; sprinkle za'atar.
Arrange cucumber, tomato, mint and olives alongside.
Serve with warm pita.
portion: 4 tbsp labneh + ½ pita + vegetables + olives

name: Beid bi Banadoura (Eggs with Tomato)
steps: Soften onion and garlic in olive oil.
Add chopped tomatoes, cumin and chilli and cook until saucy.
Crack in the eggs, cover and cook until the whites set; top with parsley and serve with pita.

name: Fatteh Hummus
steps: Toast torn pita in the oven until crisp; place in a bowl.
Top with warm chickpeas and a splash of their liquid.
Whisk yogurt with tahini, garlic, lemon and salt; spoon over.
Finish with cumin, paprika, olive oil and parsley.

name: Batata wa Beid (Potato & Egg Hash)
steps: Sauté diced potato and onion in olive oil until golden and tender.
Season with seven-spice and salt; pour in beaten eggs and stir gently until just set.
Sprinkle with sumac and parsley; serve with sliced tomato.

name: Hummus Bowl with Crudités
steps: Blend warm chickpeas with tahini, garlic, lemon, salt and ice water until very smooth.
Swirl into a bowl, drizzle olive oil and dust with paprika and cumin.
Serve with carrot, cucumber and pepper sticks and pita.

name: Shish Tawook with Tabbouleh
steps: Marinate chicken cubes in yogurt, lemon, garlic, paprika, tomato paste, a little oil and salt.
Thread on skewers and grill or broil 12–15 minutes, turning, until charred.
Soak fine bulgur in lemon juice; toss with lots of chopped parsley, mint, tomato, onion, olive oil and salt.
Serve with a spoon of garlic yogurt.
portion: 180 g chicken skewers + 1 bowl tabbouleh + garlic yogurt

name: Fattoush with Grilled Halloumi
steps: Toast pita pieces until crisp.
Chop the vegetables and herbs into a bowl.
Whisk lemon, olive oil, sumac and salt; toss with salad and pita just before serving.
Grill halloumi slices until golden and place on top with pomegranate.

name: Mujadara with Salata
steps: Simmer lentils 15 minutes until half cooked.
Slowly fry sliced onions in olive oil until deep brown; set half aside.
Add rice, lentils, spices, salt and water to the pot; cover and cook 18 minutes.
Top with crispy onions; serve with salad and yogurt.

name: Shorbat Adas (Lemony Lentil Soup)
steps: Sauté onion, carrot and garlic in olive oil.
Add lentils, potato, cumin, turmeric and water; simmer 20 minutes.
Blend until smooth, season, and serve with plenty of lemon, parsley and toasted pita.

name: Baba Ghanoush Mezze Plate
steps: Char whole eggplant on a flame or under the grill until collapsed; cool and scoop out the flesh.
Mash with tahini, garlic, lemon and salt.
Top with olive oil, pomegranate and parsley; serve with vegetables and pita.
portion: 1 plate baba ghanoush + vegetables + ½ pita

name: Baked Falafel Wrap
advancePrep: Soak dried chickpeas overnight (do not cook)
steps: Pulse soaked raw chickpeas with onion, garlic, herbs, spices and salt to a coarse paste; stir in soda.
Shape into patties, brush with oil and bake at 200 °C for 20–25 minutes, flipping once.
Thin tahini with lemon and water for the sauce.
Fill pita with falafel, salad and tahini sauce.

name: Kafta Meshwi with Salad
steps: Mix mince with grated onion, chopped parsley, seven-spice and salt; knead well.
Mould onto skewers and grill 10–12 minutes, turning.
Toss tomato, cucumber and sliced onion with sumac, lemon and olive oil; serve with pita.
portion: 3 kafta skewers (120 g) + salad + ½ pita

name: Samke Harra (Spicy Fish with Tahini)
steps: Season fish with cumin and salt and bake at 200 °C for 10 minutes.
Sauté onion, garlic, coriander and chilli in olive oil.
Whisk tahini with lemon and water until pourable; stir into the pan and spread over the fish.
Bake 10 minutes more; top with walnuts and serve with rice.
portion: 1 fillet (150 g) in sauce + ½ cup rice

name: Loubieh bi Zeit (Green Beans in Olive Oil)
steps: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil; add trimmed beans and cook 5 minutes.
Add chopped tomato, seven-spice and salt; cover and simmer until beans are soft, about 25 minutes.
Toast vermicelli, add rice and water and cook for the side.
portion: 1 bowl beans + ½ cup vermicelli rice

name: Bamieh bi Lahmeh (Okra Stew) with Rice
steps: Brown meat with onion in olive oil; add water and simmer 25 minutes.
Fry okra separately until bright; sauté garlic and coriander.
Add okra, garlic-coriander, tomato and spices to the meat; simmer 15 minutes; finish with lemon.

name: Maghmour (Lebanese Moussaka'a)
steps: Cube eggplant, toss with a little oil and roast at 220 °C until golden.
Sauté onion and garlic, add tomato, paste, chilli and chickpeas and simmer.
Fold in the eggplant and cook 10 minutes; finish with dried mint. Serve warm or at room temperature.

name: Kibbeh bil Saniyeh (Baked Kibbeh)
steps: Soak fine bulgur 15 minutes and squeeze dry; knead with two-thirds of the mince, grated onion, spices and salt.
Brown remaining mince with chopped onion and walnuts for the filling.
Press half the shell into a tray, add the filling, top with the rest; score into diamonds and brush with oil.
Bake at 200 °C for 30 minutes; serve with cucumber-mint yogurt.

name: Riz a Djej (Spiced Chicken and Rice)
steps: Poach chicken with onion and cinnamon; shred and keep the broth.
Toast rice in oil with seven-spice, add broth and cook covered.
Top with shredded chicken and toasted nuts; serve with yogurt.

name: Sayadieh (Fish and Caramelised Onion Rice)
steps: Caramelise onions slowly in oil until dark; simmer with water to make a brown stock and strain.
Cook rice in the onion stock with cumin and cinnamon.
Pan-sear seasoned fish; serve over rice with toasted almonds and lemony tahini sauce.

name: Malfouf Salad with Chickpeas
steps: Shred cabbage very finely and salt lightly.
Mash garlic with salt, lemon and olive oil; add dried mint.
Toss with cabbage, chickpeas and tomatoes; serve with pita.

name: Batata Harra (Oven Spicy Potatoes)
steps: Toss cubed potatoes with olive oil, paprika and salt; roast at 220 °C for 25–30 minutes.
Fry garlic, coriander and chilli in a little oil for a minute.
Toss potatoes with the garlic-coriander mix and lemon juice.

name: Riz bi Haleeb (Rice Pudding)
steps: Simmer rice in water until soft, then add milk and cook on low, stirring, until creamy.
Stir in sugar and orange blossom or rose water.
Chill and top with crushed pistachios.

name: Light Layali Lubnan
steps: Cook semolina in milk with sugar, stirring, until thick; add blossom water and set in a dish.
Spread whipped Greek yogurt on top once cool.
Top with banana slices, pistachios and a thin drizzle of honey; chill.

name: Sfouf (Turmeric Semolina Cake)
steps: Whisk semolina, flour, turmeric and baking powder.
Add sugar, oil and milk to form a pourable batter.
Pour into a greased tin, scatter sesame and bake at 180 °C for 30 minutes.

name: Meghli (Spiced Rice Pudding)
steps: Whisk rice flour, sugar, cinnamon and ground fennel/caraway into cold water.
Cook, stirring, until thick and glossy, about 20 minutes.
Set in bowls, chill, and top with coconut and soaked nuts.

name: Date Maamoul
steps: Rub semolina with melted ghee and rest overnight.
Knead with sugar, blossom water and a little yeast and water.
Wrap around date paste balls, press into a mould, and bake at 200 °C until just golden at the base.

name: Muhallabia with Pistachio
steps: Whisk cornflour into cold milk with sugar.
Cook, stirring, until thick; add orange blossom or rose water.
Pour into cups, chill and top with ground pistachios.

name: Congee with Egg and Greens
steps: Simmer rice with 8–10 parts water and sliced ginger, stirring occasionally, until creamy (30 minutes).
Add sliced mushrooms and greens for the last 5 minutes.
Swirl in a beaten egg or add a soft-boiled egg; finish with soy, sesame oil, spring onion and peanuts.

name: Chicken Ginger Congee
steps: Simmer rice with water and ginger until it breaks down.
Add thinly sliced chicken marinated in a little soy and cook 6 minutes.
Season and top with spring onion, coriander, pepper and sesame oil.

name: Scallion Pancake with Soy Dip
steps: Mix flours with hot water into a soft dough; rest 20 minutes.
Roll thin, brush with sesame oil, scatter spring onion and salt, roll up into a coil and flatten again.
Pan-fry in a little oil until crisp and flaky; serve with soy-vinegar dip.

name: Jianbing (Egg Crepe)
steps: Whisk the flours with water into a thin batter.
Spread thin on a hot pan, crack an egg over it, spread, and sprinkle spring onion, coriander and sesame.
Flip, brush with chilli sauce, add lettuce and fold into a rectangle.

name: Steamed Egg Custard with Rice
steps: Whisk eggs with 1.5 times their volume of warm water and salt; strain into a bowl.
Cover and steam on low 12 minutes until just set.
Drizzle soy and sesame oil, top with spring onion; serve with rice and garlicky bok choy.
portion: 1 custard bowl (2 eggs) + ½ cup rice + greens

name: Har Gow (Prawn Dumplings)
steps: Chop prawns roughly; mix with diced bamboo shoot, ginger, sesame oil, soy and salt.
Mix starch with boiling water into a translucent dough; roll small thin rounds.
Fill and pleat; steam 6–7 minutes until translucent.

name: Vegetable Baozi
steps: Knead flour with yeast, sugar and warm water; let rise until doubled.
Stir-fry finely chopped vegetables and crumbled tofu with ginger, soy and sesame oil; cool.
Roll dough rounds, fill, pleat and rest 15 minutes; steam 12–15 minutes.

name: Tomato Egg Stir-fry with Rice
steps: Scramble beaten eggs softly in half the oil; remove.
Stir-fry tomato wedges with garlic until juicy; season with sugar, soy and salt.
Return eggs, toss gently, and top with spring onion. Serve with rice.

name: Mapo Tofu with Rice
steps: Simmer cubed tofu in salted water 2 minutes; drain.
Fry chilli bean paste in oil until red; add garlic, ginger and finely chopped mushrooms.
Add water and soy, then tofu; simmer 5 minutes and thicken with cornflour slurry.
Finish with ground Sichuan (or black) pepper and spring onion; serve with rice.

name: Kung Pao Chicken with Rice
steps: Marinate diced chicken with soy and cornflour.
Mix soy, vinegar, sugar, a little cornflour and water for the sauce.
Fry dried chillies and pepper briefly, add chicken and stir-fry until cooked; add garlic, ginger, capsicum and spring onion.
Pour in sauce, toss until glossy, then stir in roasted peanuts.

name: Steamed Fish with Ginger and Scallion
steps: Lay fish on a plate over ginger slices and steam 8–10 minutes.
Drain the liquid, top with shredded ginger and spring onion.
Pour sizzling oil over and drizzle with soy and sesame oil; serve with blanched bok choy and rice.
portion: 1 fillet (160 g) + greens + ½ cup rice

name: Garlic Bok Choy with Crispy Tofu
steps: Toss tofu cubes in cornflour and pan-sear until crisp.
Stir-fry garlic briefly, add bok choy and a splash of water; cover 1 minute.
Add tofu and soy, toss and sprinkle sesame. Serve with brown rice.

name: Chicken and Broccoli Stir-fry
steps: Slice chicken and coat with a little soy and cornflour.
Blanch broccoli 1 minute.
Stir-fry chicken until golden, add garlic, ginger and broccoli.
Add soy, honey and a cornflour slurry; toss until glossy and finish with sesame oil.
portion: 1 plate (140 g chicken) + 1 cup brown rice

name: Hot and Sour Soup
steps: Simmer stock or water with sliced mushrooms, bamboo shoot, carrot and tofu.
Season with soy, vinegar, pepper and chilli.
Thicken with cornflour slurry, then drizzle in beaten egg while stirring.
Finish with sesame oil and spring onion.

name: Brown Rice Egg Fried Rice
steps: Scramble eggs in a hot wok; set aside.
Stir-fry garlic, carrot and peas, then add cold rice and toss on high heat.
Add soy, pepper and egg; finish with spring onion and sesame oil.

name: Veg Hakka Noodles
steps: Boil noodles until just done, drain and toss with a little oil.
Stir-fry garlic and julienned vegetables on very high heat.
Add noodles, soy, vinegar, chilli sauce and pepper; toss and finish with spring onion.

name: Chilli Paneer (Pan-tossed)
steps: Toss paneer cubes in cornflour and pan-sear until golden (no deep frying).
Stir-fry garlic, ginger, chillies, onion and capsicum on high heat.
Add soy, chilli sauce, vinegar and a little cornflour slurry; toss in paneer and spring onion.
portion: 1 plate (100 g paneer) + ½ cup fried rice

name: Gobi Manchurian
steps: Coat florets in a batter of maida, cornflour, salt and water; deep-fry until crisp.
Stir-fry garlic, ginger, chilli and spring onion.
Add soy, chilli sauce, vinegar and a little cornflour slurry; toss the gobi to coat.

name: Veg Manchow Soup
steps: Stir-fry garlic, ginger, coriander stems and finely chopped vegetables.
Add water, soy, chilli sauce, vinegar and pepper; simmer 5 minutes.
Thicken with cornflour slurry and finish with coriander.

name: Dan Dan Noodles
steps: Stir-fry minced pork until crisp with a splash of soy.
Whisk sesame paste, soy, chilli oil, vinegar, garlic, sugar and ground pepper in the serving bowl.
Cook noodles and bok choy; add to bowl with a little noodle water.
Top with pork, peanuts and spring onion; toss before eating.

name: Yu Xiang Eggplant with Rice
steps: Cut eggplant into batons, salt for 10 minutes and pat dry; pan-sear until soft and golden.
Fry chilli bean paste, garlic, ginger and spring onion whites.
Add soy, vinegar, sugar and water; thicken, return eggplant and toss. Serve with rice.

name: Dry-fried Green Beans with Tofu
steps: Blister beans in a hot wok with a little oil until wrinkled; set aside.
Fry crumbled tofu until golden with garlic, ginger, chillies and pepper.
Return beans, add soy and toss well. Serve with rice.

name: Char Siu Pork with Rice and Greens
steps: Marinate pork strips in honey, soy, garlic, five-spice-style spices and paprika.
Roast at 200 °C for 30–35 minutes, basting with marinade, until sticky and caramelised.
Slice and serve with rice and blanched greens drizzled with sesame oil.

name: Sweet and Sour Chicken
steps: Coat chicken pieces in egg and cornflour; deep-fry until crisp.
Stir-fry onion, capsicum and pineapple.
Add ketchup or tomato paste, vinegar, sugar, soy and water; thicken and toss in chicken.

name: Cashew Chicken with Vegetables
steps: Toast cashews in a dry wok; set aside.
Stir-fry marinated chicken until golden; add garlic, ginger and vegetables.
Add soy, honey and a little cornflour slurry; finish with cashews.

name: Szechuan Garlic Prawns
steps: Stir-fry prawns on high heat until just pink; remove.
Fry garlic, ginger and chillies, add chilli paste, soy and vinegar.
Return prawns, toss with spring onion; serve with rice and steamed broccoli.
portion: 1 plate (150 g prawns) + ½ cup rice + greens

name: Wonton Soup
steps: Mix minced pork and prawns with ginger, spring onion, soy and sesame oil.
Roll thin squares from a flour-egg dough (or use wrappers), fill and fold.
Boil wontons until they float plus 2 minutes; serve in seasoned broth with greens.

name: Chicken Sweet Corn Soup
steps: Simmer shredded chicken and half the corn in water with ginger; blend the rest of the corn and add.
Season with soy, salt and pepper; thicken with cornflour slurry.
Drizzle in beaten egg and garnish with spring onion.

name: Buddha's Delight (Mixed Veg with Tofu)
steps: Sear tofu cubes until golden.
Stir-fry garlic and ginger, add harder vegetables first, then leafy ones, with splashes of water.
Add soy and a little cornflour slurry, return tofu and toss. Serve with rice.

name: Cold Sesame Noodles with Cucumber
steps: Cook noodles, rinse under cold water and drain.
Whisk sesame paste, soy, vinegar, chilli oil, garlic and honey with a little water.
Toss noodles with sauce, cucumber, carrot and edamame; top with sesame and spring onion.

name: Tofu and Edamame Fried Rice
steps: Crumble tofu and fry until golden.
Add garlic, ginger, carrot and edamame, then cold rice on high heat.
Season with soy, sesame oil and spring onion.

name: Mango Pudding
steps: Blend ripe mango until smooth.
Cook milk with cornflour and sugar until it thickens; cool slightly.
Whisk in mango purée and yogurt; pour into cups and chill to set.

name: Sweet Potato Ginger Tong Sui
steps: Simmer peeled sweet potato chunks with sliced ginger in water for 20 minutes.
Add rock sugar or jaggery and simmer until dissolved. Serve warm.

name: Black Sesame Soup
steps: Toast sesame seeds and grind finely with a little water.
Simmer with more water, then thicken with rice-flour slurry and sweeten.

name: Hong Kong Egg Tarts
steps: Rub flour with butter, bind with a little water and press into tart tins.
Whisk eggs with warm milk and sugar; strain.
Fill shells and bake at 200 °C for 15–20 minutes until just wobbly.

name: Almond Milk Pudding with Fruit
steps: Blend milk with soaked almonds; strain.
Cook with cornflour and sugar until thick; set and chill.
Cut into cubes and serve with orange segments and berries.

name: Overnight Oats with Berries
steps: Stir oats, chia, milk and yogurt together in a jar; refrigerate overnight.
In the morning loosen with a splash of milk, top with berries, sliced almonds and a little honey.

name: Vegetable Omelette with Toast
steps: Sauté mushrooms, pepper and spinach in olive oil; season.
Pour in beaten eggs, tilt to set the edges, add cheese and fold.
Serve with whole wheat toast and sliced tomato.

name: Avocado Toast with Poached Egg
steps: Toast bread; mash avocado with lemon, salt and pepper and spread on top.
Poach the egg 3 minutes in simmering water with a splash of vinegar.
Top with egg, chilli flakes and sliced tomato.

name: Greek Yogurt Parfait
steps: Toast oats briefly in a dry pan (optional).
Layer yogurt, fruit, oats, walnuts and flax in a glass; drizzle with honey.

name: Banana Oat Pancakes
steps: Blend oats, banana, egg, milk, baking powder and cinnamon into a batter.
Cook small rounds on a lightly oiled pan until bubbles form; flip.
Serve with berries, a spoon of yogurt and a drizzle of honey.

name: Scrambled Eggs and Mushrooms on Toast
steps: Sauté sliced mushrooms in half the butter until golden; wilt spinach in at the end.
Whisk eggs with milk; cook slowly in the remaining butter, stirring, until softly set.
Serve on toast with mushrooms and spinach.

name: Apple Cinnamon Porridge
steps: Simmer oats in milk, stirring, 5–6 minutes until creamy.
Stir in grated apple and cinnamon.
Top with walnuts, chia and a little honey.

name: Berry Smoothie Bowl
steps: Blend frozen berries, banana, yogurt and milk until thick.
Pour into a bowl and top with oats, pumpkin seeds and chia.

name: Bircher Muesli
steps: Soak oats in milk and yogurt overnight.
In the morning grate in apple with a squeeze of lemon; stir.
Top with raisins, chopped almonds and honey.

name: Spinach and Feta Frittata
steps: Soften onion and pepper in olive oil in an ovenproof pan; wilt in spinach.
Pour over beaten eggs, crumble in feta and cook on low until the edges set.
Finish under the grill until puffed and golden; serve with salad.

name: Whole Wheat French Toast with Berries
steps: Whisk egg, milk and cinnamon; soak bread slices briefly.
Cook in a buttered pan until golden on both sides.
Serve with berries, yogurt and honey.

name: Minestrone with Beans
steps: Sauté onion, carrot and celery in olive oil with garlic.
Add tomato, beans, zucchini, herbs and water; simmer 15 minutes.
Add small pasta and cook until tender, then stir in spinach and basil.

name: Whole Wheat Pasta Primavera
steps: Cook pasta in salted water; reserve a cup of pasta water.
Sauté garlic and chilli in olive oil, then the vegetables until crisp-tender.
Toss in pasta with lemon, a splash of pasta water and parmesan; finish with basil.

name: Penne Arrabbiata
steps: Sizzle garlic and chilli in olive oil; add passata and simmer 10 minutes.
Cook pasta until al dente and toss in the sauce with a little pasta water.
Finish with basil; serve with a green salad.

name: Pesto Chicken Pasta
steps: Blend basil, walnuts, parmesan, garlic, lemon and olive oil into pesto.
Sear sliced chicken until cooked through.
Toss cooked pasta with pesto, chicken and halved cherry tomatoes.

name: Herb Grilled Chicken with Roasted Vegetables
steps: Marinate chicken in olive oil, garlic, lemon, herbs, salt and pepper.
Toss vegetables and potato with oil and salt; roast at 220 °C for 25 minutes.
Grill chicken 6–7 minutes per side; rest and slice.
portion: 170 g chicken + 1 cup vegetables + ½ cup potato

name: Lemon Herb Baked Fish
steps: Place fish on a tray, top with garlic, lemon slices, parsley, olive oil, salt and pepper.
Bake at 200 °C for 12–15 minutes.
Serve with steamed green beans and buttered new potatoes.
portion: 1 fillet (170 g) + vegetables + ½ cup potatoes

name: Salmon Quinoa Bowl
steps: Rinse and cook quinoa 15 minutes; fluff.
Season salmon and pan-sear skin-side down until crisp, then flip briefly.
Build bowls with quinoa, greens, vegetables, avocado and salmon; dress with lemon and oil.

name: Ratatouille with Quinoa
steps: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil; add peppers.
Add eggplant and zucchini, then tomatoes and herbs.
Simmer covered 25 minutes until silky; finish with basil. Serve with quinoa.

name: Mushroom Risotto
steps: Sauté mushrooms until browned; set aside.
Soften onion and garlic, toast the rice, then add hot stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for 18 minutes.
Stir in mushrooms, peas, butter and parmesan. Serve with a green salad.

name: Chicken and Vegetable Stew
steps: Brown chicken pieces in olive oil; remove.
Soften onion, celery and garlic; stir in flour.
Add stock, chicken, potato, carrot and herbs; simmer 30 minutes, then peas for 5. Serve with bread.

name: French Lentil Soup with Toast
steps: Sauté onion, carrot, celery and garlic in olive oil.
Add lentils, tomato, herbs and water; simmer 25 minutes.
Stir in spinach and lemon; serve with toast.

name: Light Chicken Caesar Salad
steps: Grill seasoned chicken and slice.
Cube bread and bake with a little oil into croutons.
Whisk yogurt, lemon, garlic, grated parmesan, oil and pepper into a light dressing.
Toss lettuce with dressing; top with chicken, croutons and more parmesan.

name: Salade Niçoise
steps: Boil potatoes, green beans and egg; cool.
Arrange lettuce, potatoes, beans, tomato, olives, halved egg and tuna on a plate.
Dress with olive oil, vinegar, lemon, salt and pepper.

name: Quinoa and Bean Stuffed Peppers
steps: Cook quinoa.
Sauté onion with spices; add beans, corn, tomato and quinoa.
Fill halved peppers, top with cheese and bake at 190 °C for 25 minutes.

name: Spinach Mushroom Lasagne
steps: Make a tomato-mushroom sauce with onion, garlic and herbs.
Make a white sauce with butter, flour and milk; stir in wilted spinach.
Layer dried lasagne sheets, sauces and mozzarella; finish with parmesan.
Bake at 190 °C for 35–40 minutes; rest 10 minutes before slicing.

name: Tomato Soup with Grilled Cheese
steps: Roast or sauté tomatoes, onion, carrot and garlic in olive oil; add water and simmer 15 minutes.
Blend with basil and a splash of milk; season.
Fill bread with cheese, butter the outside and toast in a pan until golden.

name: Roasted Pumpkin Soup with Seeds
steps: Roast pumpkin chunks with onion and garlic at 210 °C for 25 minutes.
Blend with ginger, cumin, hot water and coconut milk.
Top with toasted pumpkin seeds; serve with bread.

name: Chicken Meatballs in Marinara
steps: Mix minced chicken with oats, egg, grated onion, garlic, parmesan, herbs and salt; roll into balls.
Brown meatballs in olive oil; add passata and simmer 15 minutes.
Serve over pasta with basil.

name: Baked Mac and Cheese
steps: Cook pasta and broccoli; drain.
Make a sauce with butter, flour and milk; stir in most of the cheese.
Combine, top with remaining cheese and bake at 200 °C until bubbling.

name: Whole Wheat Margherita Pizza
steps: Knead flours with yeast, salt, oil and warm water; let rise.
Stretch thin, spread seasoned passata and top with mozzarella.
Bake on the hottest oven setting for 8–12 minutes; finish with basil.

name: Caprese Panzanella
steps: Toast cubed bread until crisp.
Toss tomatoes, cucumber and onion with salt, vinegar and olive oil; rest 10 minutes.
Add bread, torn mozzarella and basil; toss.

name: Oven Fish and Chips with Peas
steps: Cut potatoes into wedges, toss with oil and salt; roast at 220 °C for 30 minutes.
Dip fish in egg then breadcrumbs; bake on a greased tray for the last 15 minutes.
Crush cooked peas with mint and lemon.

name: Chicken and Vegetable Skewers with Couscous
steps: Marinate chicken in oil, lemon, garlic, paprika and oregano.
Thread with vegetables and grill 12–15 minutes, turning.
Pour boiling water over couscous, cover 5 minutes, fluff with parsley.
portion: 2 skewers (150 g chicken) + ½ cup couscous

name: Apple Oat Crumble
steps: Slice apples into a dish with cinnamon and half the honey.
Rub oats, flour and butter with remaining honey and walnuts into a crumble.
Scatter on top and bake at 190 °C for 25–30 minutes; serve with yogurt.

name: Chocolate Avocado Mousse
steps: Blend ripe avocado, banana, cocoa and jaggery or maple syrup until silky.
Chill and top with berries.

name: Yogurt Panna Cotta with Berries
steps: Warm milk with honey and cornflour (or agar) until thickened.
Whisk into yogurt, pour into cups and chill to set.
Top with a quick berry compote.

name: Banana Oat Cookies
steps: Mash banana with peanut butter; stir in oats, raisins, cinnamon and chopped chocolate.
Scoop onto a lined tray and flatten.
Bake at 180 °C for 12–15 minutes.

name: Berry Chia Pudding
steps: Stir chia into milk with honey; stir again after 10 minutes.
Chill until set and top with berries.

name: Dark Chocolate Dipped Strawberries
steps: Melt dark chocolate gently.
Dip strawberries halfway and set on parchment until firm.

name: Fudgy Brownies
steps: Melt chocolate with butter; whisk in sugar and eggs.
Fold in flour, cocoa and walnuts.
Bake at 175 °C for 20–25 minutes; cool before slicing.

name: Shakshuka
steps: Soften onion, pepper and garlic in olive oil; add cumin, paprika and chilli.
Add chopped tomatoes and simmer until thick, about 10 minutes.
Make wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook until set; top with feta and parsley.

name: Japanese Breakfast Set
steps: Cook short-grain rice.
Dissolve miso in hot (not boiling) water with tofu cubes and spring onion.
Salt and grill salmon until just flaky.
Toss sliced cucumber with vinegar, sugar and salt; blanch spinach and dress with soy.
portion: 1 bowl rice + miso soup + salmon + pickled cucumber

name: Huevos Rancheros
steps: Warm tortillas in a dry pan.
Simmer beans with onion, garlic, cumin, chilli and tomato into a quick sauce.
Fry eggs sunny side up; place on tortillas with beans and sauce.
Top with avocado, coriander and a squeeze of lime.

name: Breakfast Burrito
steps: Sauté onion and pepper; add spinach and beans with cumin.
Scramble eggs softly.
Fill tortillas with eggs, vegetables, cheese and salsa; roll and toast seam-side down.

name: Menemen
steps: Soften peppers and onion in olive oil and butter.
Add grated tomatoes and cook until thick.
Stir in beaten eggs gently until just set; serve with bread, cucumber and olives.

name: Gyeran Bap (Egg Rice)
steps: Fry eggs with crispy edges.
Place over hot rice with soy sauce and sesame oil.
Top with spring onion and sesame; serve with seasoned blanched spinach. Mix before eating.

name: Tamagoyaki with Onigiri
steps: Whisk eggs with sugar and soy; cook in thin layers in a pan, rolling each layer into a log.
Shape warm salted rice into triangles and sprinkle with sesame.
Slice the omelette; serve with cucumber.

name: Greek Yogurt with Honey, Walnuts and Fruit
steps: Spoon yogurt into a bowl.
Top with orange segments, toasted walnuts, cinnamon and a drizzle of honey.

name: Thai Green Curry with Tofu
steps: Fry green curry paste in oil until fragrant.
Add coconut milk, lemongrass and a little water; simmer.
Add vegetables and tofu and cook until just tender; season with soy, palm sugar and lime.
Finish with Thai basil; serve with jasmine rice.

name: Tom Yum Soup with Prawns
steps: Simmer water with bruised lemongrass, galangal or ginger, and chillies for 5 minutes.
Add mushrooms, tomato and onion, then prawns until pink.
Season off heat with fish sauce, chilli paste and lime juice; garnish with coriander. Small portion of rice on the side.

name: Pad Thai with Tofu and Egg
steps: Mix tamarind, palm sugar and fish sauce (or soy) into the sauce.
Fry garlic and tofu, push aside and scramble the egg.
Add soaked noodles and sauce; toss until absorbed.
Add sprouts and spring onion; serve with peanuts, chilli and lime.

name: Pad Kra Pao (Basil Chicken) with Rice
steps: Pound garlic and chillies.
Stir-fry with minced or chopped chicken until cooked; add capsicum.
Season with soy, fish sauce and sugar; toss in lots of basil.
Serve over rice with a crispy fried egg.
portion: 1 plate (140 g chicken) + rice + fried egg

name: Larb Gai (Chicken Herb Salad)
steps: Toast raw rice until golden and grind coarsely.
Poach minced chicken in a splash of water until just cooked.
Toss warm chicken with lime, fish sauce, chilli, shallots, herbs and toasted rice powder.
Serve in lettuce leaves with cucumber.
portion: 1 plate (140 g chicken) + lettuce cups + small sticky rice

name: Som Tam (Green Papaya Salad)
steps: Shred green papaya finely.
Pound garlic and chillies in a mortar; add beans, tomato, palm sugar, lime and soy (or fish sauce).
Add papaya and pound lightly while tossing; top with peanuts.
portion: 1 plate + small portion of sticky rice

name: Teriyaki Chicken Bowl
steps: Sear chicken thigh pieces until golden.
Add soy, honey, ginger, garlic and a little cornflour slurry; reduce to a glaze.
Serve over rice with steamed broccoli and carrot; sprinkle sesame and spring onion.

name: Miso Glazed Salmon with Greens
steps: Mix miso, honey, soy and ginger; brush over salmon and marinate.
Bake at 210 °C for 10–12 minutes (grill the last 2 for colour).
Stir-fry bok choy with garlic and sesame oil; serve with rice.
portion: 1 fillet (140 g) + greens + ½ cup rice

name: Cold Soba Salad with Edamame
steps: Cook soba, rinse in cold water.
Whisk soy, rice vinegar, sesame oil, grated ginger and honey.
Toss noodles with edamame, cucumber, carrot and dressing; top with sesame and spring onion.

name: Tuna Poke-style Bowl
steps: Cook rice and season with rice vinegar.
Toss tuna with soy, sesame oil and spring onion.
Arrange rice, tuna, edamame, cucumber, carrot and avocado; drizzle with spicy mayo-free chilli sauce and sesame.

name: Bibimbap
steps: Blanch spinach and sprouts; season each with sesame oil, garlic and salt.
Sauté carrot, mushroom and zucchini separately; pan-sear tofu.
Arrange over rice with a fried egg; serve with gochujang thinned with sesame oil. Mix well.

name: Spicy Cabbage Fried Rice
steps: Stir-fry chopped cabbage with garlic, gochujang and a splash of vinegar (or chopped kimchi if you have it).
Add cold rice and soy; toss on high heat.
Top with a fried egg, spring onion and sesame oil.

name: Dubu Jorim (Braised Tofu) with Rice
steps: Pan-fry tofu slabs until golden on both sides.
Pour over a sauce of soy, chilli flakes, garlic, honey, spring onion and water.
Simmer until the sauce reduces; serve with rice and seasoned spinach.

name: Black Bean Burrito Bowl
steps: Cook brown rice with lime and coriander.
Warm beans with cumin, chilli and salt.
Build bowls with rice, beans, corn, lettuce, tomato-onion salsa, avocado and a spoon of yogurt.

name: Chicken Fajitas
steps: Toss sliced chicken with spices, garlic, lime and a little oil.
Sear in a very hot pan; add peppers and onion and cook until charred but crisp.
Serve in warm tortillas with salsa and yogurt.

name: Black Bean Soup
steps: Sauté onion, pepper and garlic with cumin and chilli.
Add beans, tomato and water; simmer 15 minutes and partly blend.
Finish with lime and coriander; top with avocado and toasted tortilla strips.

name: Chicken Tortilla Soup
steps: Sauté onion and garlic with spices; add tomato and water.
Poach chicken in the soup, then shred; add corn and beans.
Serve topped with baked tortilla strips, avocado, lime and coriander.

name: Greek Salad with Chickpeas
steps: Chop tomato, cucumber, pepper and onion into chunks.
Add chickpeas and olives; dress with olive oil, vinegar, oregano and salt.
Top with a slab of feta.

name: Chicken Souvlaki with Tzatziki and Pita
steps: Marinate chicken in lemon, garlic, oregano, olive oil and salt; thread on skewers.
Grill 10–12 minutes, turning.
Grate cucumber, squeeze dry and mix with yogurt, garlic, mint and salt.
Serve with warm pita, tomato and onion.
portion: 2 skewers (150 g chicken) + pita + salad + tzatziki

name: Chickpea and Vegetable Tagine with Couscous
steps: Sauté onion, garlic and ginger in olive oil with the spices.
Add sweet potato, carrot, tomato and water; simmer 15 minutes.
Add zucchini, chickpeas and raisins and simmer 10 more.
Serve over fluffed couscous with coriander.

name: Chicken Pho
steps: Char onion and ginger; simmer in water with cinnamon and cloves and the chicken for 30 minutes.
Remove and shred chicken; season the broth with fish sauce and salt.
Pour hot broth over soaked noodles and chicken; serve with sprouts, herbs, lime and chilli.

name: Nasi Goreng
steps: Pound shallots, garlic and chilli into a paste and fry until fragrant.
Add vegetables, then cold rice, sweet soy (soy + palm sugar); toss on high heat.
Serve with a fried egg, cucumber and tomato.

name: Gado Gado
steps: Boil potato, green beans, cabbage and egg; blanch sprouts. Pan-sear tofu.
Whisk peanut butter with garlic, chilli, palm sugar, soy, lime and warm water into a sauce.
Arrange everything on a plate with cucumber; pour sauce over.

name: Chicken and Prawn Paella
steps: Brown chicken in olive oil in a wide pan; add onion, garlic and pepper.
Stir in grated tomato, paprika and saffron, then the rice.
Add hot stock, do not stir, and simmer 18 minutes; nestle in prawns and peas for the last 6.
Rest 5 minutes; serve with lemon and parsley.

name: Gazpacho with Toast
steps: Blend ripe tomatoes, cucumber, pepper, onion, garlic, vinegar and olive oil until smooth.
Season and chill well.
Serve cold with toast and diced cucumber on top.

name: Mediterranean Quinoa Salad
steps: Cook quinoa and cool.
Toss with chickpeas, chopped vegetables, olives and parsley.
Dress with lemon, olive oil and salt; crumble feta on top.

name: Mango Sticky Rice
steps: Steam soaked sticky rice 20–25 minutes.
Warm coconut milk with sugar and salt; pour most of it over the hot rice and rest 15 minutes.
Serve with sliced mango, remaining coconut sauce and toasted sesame.

name: Moroccan Orange Cinnamon Salad
steps: Peel oranges and slice into thin rounds.
Sprinkle with cinnamon and orange blossom water.
Top with mint, chopped pistachios and dates.

name: Yaki Imo (Roasted Sweet Potato)
steps: Wash sweet potato and wrap in foil.
Roast at 180 °C for 50–60 minutes until caramelised and soft inside.

name: Bananas in Coconut Milk
steps: Simmer coconut milk with palm sugar and a pinch of salt.
Add banana chunks and cook 3–4 minutes until soft.
Serve warm with toasted sesame.

name: Fırın Sütlaç (Baked Rice Pudding)
steps: Cook rice in water until soft, then add milk and simmer.
Thicken with rice flour mixed with milk; add sugar.
Pour into ovenproof bowls and grill until browned on top; chill and dust with cinnamon.
